chapter_note: Heavily damaged chapter (80.7% damage) tracking cosmic time-phases — the summoning of the Mother of Life, descent of the First Man to battle, the Great Builder's depiction of the cosmos (Living Spirit, Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Virgin of Light, Pillar of Glory), Matter's five elements/worlds, and concluding with enumerated eschatology (Third/Fourth: release of cosmos, 1468 years burning, Darkness into tomb). The 'Third is.../Fourth is the release...' enumeration at i=179, 183 is classic substrate eschatology preserved intact.
